note: Marisa's own hat turned over as soft cloth: a nest on land, a pleated bowl afloat. Model units (16 per block) at growth 1. The opening and brim sizes come from the worn hat; these are the cloth's shape, the aquatic hat's size, where the braid holds it, the young's places, how a helper is placed, and the pregnant body used to find the live exit.
lore: user 2026-10-15: turned over, the hat's top is soft and becomes a nest-like structure (a rigid hat does not suit catching); reference EH22-001, EH22-006/007 (wiki/art-references/ehentai): the floating hat is a pleated bowl with a scalloped brim lying on the water, Marisa sitting in it, things kept in it
aquatic_scale_lore: the aquatic Marisa's hat is larger than a land Marisa's so it carries her young and food as a small dry boat (user, 2026-10-14)

nest.lore: on the ground the soft crown folds under into a low round nest, the brim drooping to the ground round it (user 2026-10-15)

bowl.lore: afloat the crown is a deep soft bowl under the water and the brim lies on it (EH22); the mother sits low in the bowl at the stern; by day the young ride in the dry bowl before her, at night they sleep in it under her (user, 2026-10-14)

grip_lore: on the head the braid hooks one brim point on its own side (saved braid interactions v2 take the hat by one brim point), chosen so it is also in reach when the turned-over hat is pressed down and the hat turned so that point comes toward the braid (the nest's long axis lies across the mother either way); set down, the braid holds the soft rim

float.lore: at a bank the aquatic Marisa catches in her hat floated at the water's edge before the outlet, its near brim slipped under the bank; a newborn pushed too hard flies past it into the river (user, 2026-10-14). bank_drop: the water surface below the bank top

helper.lore: the helper keeps clear of the swollen mother and of the hat's brim (user 2026-10-15: the father stood too close and went through), holds the rim on her braid side and looks toward the outlet

pregnancy.lore: LiveBirthGeometry.deform; used for the live exit (the body's half width at a full belly)
